purpose: Real-weight engineering dependency, finite-gradient and same-process restore check; not a training or efficacy experiment.
hypothesis: The separate text-conditioned mask baseline can use Qwen text features to change an EO mask and propagate a finite mask-loss gradient to the original OlmoEarth encoder.

identity.coverage: Original EO weights/config, six selected EO source files, 14 Qwen model/tokenizer assets plus one auxiliary HF download-cache JSON, prepared manifest, contexts and complete 232-file episode export. Not the entire EO source tree or dependency environment.

sample.selection_rule: lexicographically first train K1 episode whose positive support class is8; no query-gold or score selection
sample.support_positions: all 8 preselected observations per support object
sample.query_gold_may_be_used_for: one train-only mask loss backward; no selection or performance score

configuration.qwen_input: text only; Qwen does not consume EO/RGB in this adapter
configuration.initialization: original pinned public EO; same new head for all five conditions

gates.identity: All externally pinned source/input identities match before actual model execution.
gates.text_dependency: Same-input matched_knowledge versus names_only max absolute mask-logit difference > 0. This is numerical dependency only.
gates.removal: removed_knowledge_diagnostic versus names_only max absolute difference == 0.
gates.gradients: All present parameter gradients finite; nonzero tensors in EO encoder and mask head; zero nonzero-gradient tensors in frozen Qwen and unused original connector.
gates.restore: After no optimizer step, same-process saved trainable state reload max absolute matched-condition logit difference <= 1e-6.
diagnostics_only: swapped knowledge versus names logit difference
gates.pass_interpretation: Engineering connection only; all gates required. No learning adequacy, semantic knowledge use, causal explanation, correction efficiency or CVPR claim.

launch_requirements: Frozen original P2 ended AND audit completed; a capped incomplete P2 is reported incomplete, not rescued.
Atomically persist a unique reservation in the cumulative pilot ledger; no prior duplicate owned job.
Check physical GPU1 is idle immediately before launch and record UUID; never stop another person process.
External process-group timeout <=1800 seconds with durable exit/actual-occupancy receipt; include retries/inference.
Record Python/Torch/Transformers/CUDA environment and actual source/config hashes.
Review launcher without changing frozen model or data; no standalone --execute invocation.
stop_rules: Fail on any identity, loss/gradient, dependency or restore gate failure; retain artifacts.
Stop at timeout or resource failure; no automatic retry outside remaining cumulative budget.
No optimizer comparison until optimizer/RNG and fresh-process resume have separately been verified.
limits: One selected training episode, no development or final-region scoring.
Only seven unique context strings across the parent pack; agricultural understanding and class-code effects are not separated.
Public-source AI summaries are not expert corrections; human responses remain zero.
No generated-language evaluation or transfer/label-efficiency result.
This common conditional baseline is not a proposed-method novelty claim.
